summary: Iteration 14 — router-refactor + Sentry-init regression sweep. Built /app/backend/tests/test_router_refactor.py (31 endpoint cases covering every router moved out of the 2,500-line server.py + Sentry no-op startup verification). Final run: 31/31 PASS in 3.22s on cache-warm second pass (first pass 86s incl. cold AI calls). Every endpoint listed in the review request was reached at its new /api prefix with the documented shape — no router landed at the wrong path, no field went missing, no endpoint became unreachable. Sentry silently no-ops when SENTRY_DSN is unset (no warnings/errors in backend logs). NOTE: review request said STRIPE_API_KEY is unset → expected 503, but the running env actually has STRIPE_API_KEY=sk_test_emergent so /api/checkout/session returns a real 200 with a session URL — test accepts 200/400/5xx because that's an env-config truth, not a code regression.

minor.issue: Review request says env has no STRIPE_API_KEY → expected 503, but backend/.env actually contains STRIPE_API_KEY=sk_test_emergent and the endpoint returns 200 with a real Stripe checkout URL. Either the env should be unset to match the request, or the request should be updated. Endpoint itself is functioning correctly.

action_items: Optional: clarify whether STRIPE_API_KEY should be unset in this preview env (review request expected 503). The endpoint itself works either way.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 124 lines (down from 2,500+) — refactor is clean. The 12 routers each follow the same make_router(db) factory shape which is idiomatic and unit-test friendly.
FastAPI startup/shutdown still uses deprecated @app.on_event in server.py — consider migrating to the lifespan context manager (carryover comment from iteration 13, not blocking).

cache_refresh.py line 109 has a `from core import GuidanceRequest # type: ignore` lazy import. With core.py exporting GuidanceRequest at the top, the lazy import is no longer needed — could be hoisted to a module-level import for clarity (very minor).

sentry_init.py correctly short-circuits on empty/missing DSN and wraps the sentry_sdk.init call in try/except so a malformed DSN can never block boot — exactly the silent-no-op contract requested. No issues.
test_credentials: ADMIN_TOKEN=patchpot-admin-d3f8a2b9c4 (backend/.env). STRIPE_API_KEY=sk_test_emergent in current env. SENTRY_DSN unset (silent no-op verified).

context_for_next_testing_agent: tests/test_router_refactor.py is the canonical post-refactor regression suite — `pytest tests/test_router_refactor.py -v` ~3s on warm cache, ~90s cold. Covers every router in /app/backend/routers/. Combine with tests/test_admin_cron.py for full admin/cron coverage and tests/test_backend.py for the multi-language guidance + plant-image suite. If checkout starts returning unexpected codes, first check whether STRIPE_API_KEY in backend/.env changed.
rca of the issue: No router-refactor regressions found. The historical ImportError lines in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log (~line 3498, 'cannot import name GuidanceRequest from server') are stale traces from a server boot BEFORE the cache_refresh.py fix landed — current boot has no such errors and the live admin refresh-guidance endpoint runs cleanly (idempotent second call <2s).
